formal_selection: Choose one global (chunk,grid) minimizing geometric-mean full GPU latency / NATIVE over both development processes and all shapes/offsets, using the faster orientation per development condition. Freeze geometry before confirmation. Each confirmation allocation selects MATCH or INVERT on 12 randomized calibration blocks then freezes it for disjoint testing.
sm_preference: SM%10 in {4,5,6,7} => class1, others class0; historical empirical hypothesis only
address_class: parity((workspace_virtual_address>>12)&0x33); assumes VA class transfers and tests both orientations; not physical home proof
task_queue: two lists of page-local chunks, each CTA first takes its preferred list then steals from the other; no grid sync, no residency reservation; actual assignment traced separately
fused: Original CUTLASS MMA plus per-tile release counter; last arriving producer CTA performs ordered reduction; no spin wait; one kernel; counters reset by last CTA for the next serialized replay.
controls: same queue machinery without SM-address preference; inverted and shuffled address labels; direct reducer without queue; original CUTLASS; cuBLAS
primary: Complete GEMM start-event to end-event; CPU submit-to-output-ready also recorded
costs: all launch, atomics, counter resets, reduction and mapping loads included; input copies/calibration/CPU lists/graph setup separate
health: 100W unchanged; stop at 82C; exclusive worker flock
